note: MyDesk Vault provides tested clean-room subsets of engineering product data management, content-addressed versioning, check-in/check-out locking, CAD relationships, and BOM generation. FUNCTIONAL entries do not imply complete Autodesk Vault parity or multi-user server capability.

capabilities.name: Content-addressed file tracking and cryptographic hashing
capabilities.reference_behavior: Store engineering documents with cryptographic content checksums and initial revision markers.
capabilities.expected_input: File path, binary/text payload, author metadata
capabilities.expected_output: Vault record with unique file ID and verifiable content hash
capabilities.differences: SHA-256 content addressing is verified against FIPS 180-4 vectors; external blob stores and streaming multi-gigabyte hashing remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Check-out and check-in exclusive locking
capabilities.reference_behavior: Acquire exclusive editing lock on check-out and reject concurrent modifications until check-in with new version.
capabilities.expected_input: File ID, user credentials, commit payload
capabilities.expected_output: Strict mutual exclusion and incremental version creation

capabilities.name: Undo check-out and lock release
capabilities.reference_behavior: Release lock without incrementing version number or modifying repository contents.
capabilities.expected_output: Lock cleared and previous committed version preserved

capabilities.name: Engineering lifecycle state transitions and revision advancement
capabilities.reference_behavior: Manage WorkInProgress, ForReview, and Released lifecycle states, locking Released items and bumping revision on change.
capabilities.expected_output: Enforced state rules and updated revision letter
capabilities.differences: Released state modification lock and revision advancement verified.

capabilities.name: CAD assembly relationship graph and Where-Used queries
capabilities.reference_behavior: Traverse parent-child CAD references to locate all parent assemblies containing a given component.
capabilities.expected_output: Complete list of parent assembly file IDs
capabilities.performance: In-memory graph traversal for the tested repository sizes
capabilities.differences: Direct relationship editing, cycle rejection, and transitive where-used traversal are verified. Persistent graph indexing, CAD-reference extraction, suppression states, and server-scale query planning are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Hierarchical Bill of Materials (BOM) extraction
capabilities.reference_behavior: Extract parts list and component revisions from assembly structure for manufacturing release.
capabilities.expected_output: Structured BOM item list with revisions and quantities
capabilities.performance: In-memory recursive traversal for the tested repository sizes
capabilities.differences: Recursive BOM traversal and repeated-component quantity aggregation are verified. Item masters, effectivity, units, phantom assemblies, variants, and released manufacturing BOM workflows are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Native repository catalog serialization and round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save and load native .myvault repository catalog preserving file IDs, paths, states, and dependencies.
capabilities.expected_output: Full round-trip restoration of repository structure
capabilities.performance: Structural JSON parsing with validation and same-directory atomic replacement
capabilities.differences: Schema-v2 structural parsing, binary content, histories, locks, dependencies, audit logs, v1 migration, hash validation, validated same-directory replacement, backup retention, and desktop save/reopen are verified; fsync durability and unknown-field preservation remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Persistent engineering repository workspace
capabilities.command: FILE / ADD / CHECKOUT / CHECKIN / LIFECYCLE / BOM / WHERE_USED
capabilities.reference_behavior: Manage engineering files, versions, locks, lifecycle, relationships, BOMs, and audit history through a persistent desktop repository interface.
capabilities.expected_input: Local engineering file content, vault paths, users, lifecycle commands, dependency edits, repository paths, and export paths
capabilities.expected_output: Engine-backed versioned repository mutations, editable file metadata, recursive relationship views, reversible UI commands, saved repository, BOM CSV, and retrieved version content
manual_tests: Add two engineering files, create a component relationship, check out and check in a revision, change lifecycle state, inspect BOM/where-used/audit, save, close, and reopen
capabilities.performance: Interactive local in-memory repository operations for the tested project sizes
capabilities.differences: The Qt workflow is a substantive local single-user PDM client, not Autodesk Vault parity. Authentication, authorization, database/server transactions, multi-user synchronization, CAD add-ins, job processing, conflict resolution, replication, thumbnails, and Autodesk Vault interoperability are not implemented.
